package_name: Stratus Red Team — Entra ID / Persistence
summary: 7 Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation techniques for Entra ID Persistence.
description: Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation techniques for Entra ID targeting the Persistence tactic. Each script invokes the official Stratus binary using an isolated Morgana correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation. Prerequisite cloud infrastructure is managed by Stratus warmup. Cleanup is performed via the separate cleanup_command using the same correlation ID.
purpose: Validate Entra ID Persistence detection rules, SIEM alerts, and SOC workflows in an authorized cloud sandbox.
capabilities: 7 Stratus Red Team techniques for Entra ID Persistence.
Official Stratus binary execution — no custom attack code.
Morgana Test ID used as Stratus correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation.
Separate detonate + cleanup lifecycle with state preservation.
use_cases: Validate Entra ID Persistence detection in an authorized cloud sandbox.
Exercise SIEM, CSPM, cloud-native detection, and SOC workflows with real cloud API activity.
Confirm detection rules fire on real technique execution before incident response exercises.
prerequisites: Azure CLI authenticated with Entra ID permissions (az login).
Entra ID tenant with appropriate role assignments (User Administrator, Global Administrator for some techniques).
Authorized test tenant — never run against production identity.
safety_notes: Stratus Red Team is designed for authorized sandbox cloud environments only.
Never execute against production cloud accounts, subscriptions, or clusters.
Some techniques create real cloud resources that incur cost — always run cleanup after detonation.
Warmup may take 1–5 minutes for Terraform-based infrastructure setup.
Cleanup uses the same correlation ID; ensure MORGANA_TEST_ID matches the detonation Test.
author: Datadog / Stratus Red Team

scripts.name: STRATUS - ENTRA - Backdoor Entra ID application
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for Entra ID.

Backdoor Entra ID application

Backdoors an existing Entra ID application by creating a new password credential. Warm-up: - Create an Entra ID application and associated service principal - Assign it the Directory Readers role at the tenant level (for illustration purposes) Detonation: - Backdoor the Entra ID application by creating a new password credential Notes: The warm-up mimics what happens when you create an App Registration through the Azure portal. When you use the Azure portal, creating an App Registration automatic

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Backdoor Entra ID application
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_azure_subscription}" ]; then export AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID="#{stratus_azure_subscription}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=entra-id.persistence.backdoor-application"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate entra-id.persistence.backdoor-application
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=entra-id.persistence.backdoor-application"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"entra-id.persistence.backdoor-application\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup entra-id.persistence.backdoor-application
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=entra-id.persistence.backdoor-application"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT

scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for Entra ID.

Create Sticky Backdoor User Through Restricted Management AU

Creates a [restricted management Administrative Unit (AU)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/admin-units-restricted-management), and places a backdoor account in it to simulate a protected attacker-controlled user. Warm-up: - Create an Entra ID backdoor user Detonation: - Create restricted management Administrative Unit - Add the backdoor user to the Administrative Unit References: - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-contr

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.

# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_azure_subscription}" ]; then export AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID="#{stratus_azure_subscription}"; fi

fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=entra-id.persistence.restricted-au"
